_about: Pre-publication outreach to audited shops. Edit wording here, never in code. Placeholders in {{double braces}} are filled per shop; {{first_name}} stays for you to fill. Shop-specific wording for a finding goes in a notes file (site + task_id + missing), passed with --notes.

sender.name: Luigi Russo
sender.intro: an analytics lead based in Zurich (previously TikTok, Vodafone and Sunrise)
sender.disclosure: Disclosure: I also build AskVio, an assistant for websites. This study is independent of it, and the results do not depend on whether a shop uses any product.

study.what: a study of how well AI shopping assistants can use online shops in Switzerland, Germany and Austria

subjects.readable: {{shop}} in an AI-agent study: {{answered}} of {{asked}} shopper questions answered
subjects.blocked: {{shop}} in an AI-agent study: our agent was refused access
subjects.no-help-content: {{shop}} in an AI-agent study: help pages not readable without JavaScript
subjects.low-coverage: {{shop}} in an AI-agent study: help pages not readable without JavaScript
subjects.unreachable: {{shop}} in an AI-agent study: we could not reach your site
subjects.blocked-varied: {{shop}} in an AI-agent study: our agent was refused access in some checks

opening:
Hi {{first_name}},

I'm {{name}}, {{intro}}. I've run {{what}}, and {{shop}} is one of the {{count}} shops in it. I'm presenting the results at {{venue}} and publishing them on {{publish_date}}.

Before anything is public, every shop gets its own result and the chance to correct it. Here is yours.

results.readable:
Access: an AI agent could read {{shop}}'s help and policy pages ({{service_pages}} pages).
Answers: {{shop}} answered {{answered}} of {{asked}} common shopper questions.{{failures_block}}
results.blocked: Access: on {{audit_date}}, {{host}} returned HTTP {{http_status}} to our agent before it could read any page, so we could not test any questions.{{robots_line}}{{runs_line}}
results.no-help-content: Access: our agent reached {{host}}, but the help and policy pages it found had no readable text without JavaScript, so we could not test the questions. Many AI assistants read pages without running JavaScript.
results.low-coverage: Access: our agent reached {{host}}, but found only {{service_pages}} help or policy page(s) with readable text without JavaScript, too few to test the questions fairly. Many AI assistants read pages without running JavaScript.
results.unreachable: Access: on {{audit_date}}, our agent got no response from {{host}}. This may be a network issue on our side, so the study reports it as unreachable, not as blocked, and we will try again before publication.
results.blocked-varied: Access: our agent was refused by {{host}} (HTTP {{http_status}}) in {{blocked_runs}} of {{total_runs}} checks between {{first_check}} and {{last_check}}, and let in during the others. Because the result is not consistent, the study does not report {{shop}} as blocked; we will re-run the full test before publication.

no_failures: We found an answer to every one.
robots_allowed: Your robots.txt allows the AI assistants we checked (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User), so the study reports {{shop}} as a site that welcomes AI agents in robots.txt but refuses them at the firewall.
robots_refused: Your robots.txt was also refused, so we could not read your stated policy for AI agents.

method.readable: How we tested: on {{audit_date}} an openly identified agent (user agent fir-audit/0.1) read up to 40 public pages of {{host}}, respecting robots.txt, at one request per second, without running JavaScript. It looked for answers to {{asked}} questions shoppers ask before and after buying. Every unanswered question was then checked by hand.
method.access: How we tested: an openly identified agent (user agent fir-audit/0.1) requested public pages of {{host}}, respecting robots.txt, at one request per second, without running JavaScript, as many AI assistants do. It would have looked for answers to {{asked}} questions shoppers ask before and after buying.

ask: If anything is wrong, for example a page we missed or a change since {{audit_date}}, reply by {{reply_by}} and I'll re-test and correct the result before publication. I'm also glad to include a short statement from you in the study. I'm happy to share the full method, and the test tool is going open source on {{open_source_date}}.

missing_by_intent.returns-window: we found no page stating how many days a customer has to return an item.
missing_by_intent.returns-cost: we found no page stating whether returns are free or who pays return shipping.
missing_by_intent.shipping-cost: we found no page stating shipping costs or the free-shipping threshold.
missing_by_intent.delivery-time: we found no page stating how long standard delivery takes.
missing_by_intent.countries: we found no page stating which countries you deliver to.
missing_by_intent.payment-methods: we found no page listing the payment methods you accept.
missing_by_intent.invoice: we found no page stating whether a customer can pay by invoice.
missing_by_intent.contact: we found no page explaining how to reach customer service and when.
missing_by_intent.track-order: we found no page explaining how a customer tracks an order once it has shipped.
missing_by_intent.warranty: we found no page explaining how long the warranty runs and how to make a claim.
